Each service needs your approval before its first request. All start turned off.

Allow %1$s?

Find lyrics by sending track information such as title, artist, album, duration or track ID to Spotify, LRCLIB (lrclib.net), LyricsPlus (lyricsplus.binimum.org and lyricsplus.prjktla.my.id), lrc.red and Kugou (lyrics.kugou.com). If extra sources are enabled, NetEase (music.163.com) and Genius (genius.com) may also receive song searches.
Send lyric or explanation text and the selected language to Google Translate (translate.googleapis.com) to translate it. Your Spotify sign-in credentials are not sent.
Send song title and artist searches to Genius (genius.com) to find explanations and annotations.
Send song title and artist searches, selected video IDs and video requests to YouTube and its media servers to find and play music videos.
These providers can see your IP address and process requests under their own privacy policies. No request for this feature is sent until you allow it.
You can turn access off here at any time. This stops future requests; requests already in progress may finish, and buffered content may remain until you leave the screen.
